reviews.text: The place is small but tidy, fragrant, and well-stocked. I went there to buy a leash that they didn't have at the time, but they went out of their way to get it for me, calling the supplier and making sure they had the right product. The staff was truly kind and professional.
The best in Milan. Professional, kind, especially the blonde lady.

I bought some dog food, but as soon as you enter you notice the professionalism of the managers, at that moment there was a wonderful Labrador wagging his tail happily waiting to go "for a bath" and that says it all, congratulations..
A great experience for my dog! All it needs is a little cuddles, treats, and more attention for the puppies, but I'd love to go back.

They are two very kind people and animal lovers. They are professional and care about the well-being of your furry friends. They were recommended to me by my vet, and now, for years, they have been caring for my four-legged children.

They might be the best groomer in Milan, but it's impossible to book. They always say they're booked for months and leave no hope of booking. After countless attempts, I've crossed this name off my groomer list. It's pointless to call. What a shame.
I took my little dog to BAU-HOUSE for a bath, ear cleaning, and nail trimming, and it's always a pleasure to see the owners' great professionalism in pet care.
Excellent even for dogs that are difficult to groom. Book well in advance.
